scope: CI and pytest alignment for final module system

fixes_applied.change: scripts/run_backend_tests.sh now waits for a real SQLAlchemy connection to the mapped PostgreSQL port and retries Alembic startup.
Integration test environments set DB_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 to avoid PostgreSQL idle-in-transaction disconnects during slow test runs.
Foundation and n8n derived response serializers preserve internal org_id while final API schemas still exclude org_id from output.
n8n job payload metadata was renamed from credential fields to dispatch_binding to comply with sensitive-field rejection.
Tests snapshot ORM fields inside active sessions before assertions.
